Wang Lung (to O-lan): "Now when I go to the great temple on the Festival of the Lantern, I shall buy a gold pin for the hair of my jewel, and I shall wear it myself on my head, for I have grown old, and the jewels of a great woman are needed in a man's hair!"
[action] O-lan rewraps the pearls in a rag and presses them against her heart.

Wang Lung (to O-lan): "I have changed my mind, O-lan. I am a fool, and I have never loved another. I love only you, O-lan, and these two pearls shall be the jewels of a great woman, and you shall wear them on your head, and I shall look at them when I go to the great temple."
[action] (to Wang Lung) O-lan carefully rewraps the pearls.

Wang Lung (to O-lan): "Take these pearls, then, and go and wear them on your head. I do not know why I have loved you all these years. I suppose it is because I have never loved any other, and I suppose it is because you are my wife and because you are a woman and because I love you and that is all. But in this way I am a fool, and I will give the jewels of a great woman to a great woman. Take them, O-lan."
[silence] O-lan says nothing.
Wang Lung (to O-lan): "I have never loved any other woman. I love only you, O-lan. Therefore these pearls must be yours and you must wear them on your head."
[action] O-lan presses the pearls to her breast and rests them there.
[action] (to Wang Lung) O-lan slowly takes out the pearls from her bosom and hides them.
[action] (to O-lan) Wang Lung and O-lan go to the kitchen
[action] (to O-lan) Wang Lung takes the pearls from O-lan
[action] Wang Lung puts pearls in his robe

Wang Lung (to O-lan): "These jewels are for Lotus, the little girl at the tea shop. When she comes, I will give them to her. I have no right to wear them on my head, and she shall wear them. For I have not loved any other, only you, O-lan, and only you shall wear them."
[action] (to Wang Lung) O-lan hides her hands

wang_lung.raw: I want to show O-lan the pearls I gave her, but I fear her silence, for I have spent too much on Lotus and feel the weight of my shame.

o_lan.raw: I will not ask for the pearls back, nor speak of them, but I will keep them close, as they are the only thing that makes me feel he still sees me.
